purpose: Safely discover relevant property legal-life answers, timelines, events, legal topics and official sources without treating search similarity as proof of property identity, legal correctness or evidence.
core_principle: SEARCH → CANDIDATES → SCOPE CHECK → ACCESS CHECK → RELEVANCE → OPEN APPROVED CONTENT
rules: Semantic similarity is not property identity.
Names and addresses alone must not silently merge properties or people.
Current and historical results remain distinct.
Private cases require authorization and are never exposed through public search.
Search ordering must not imply legal correctness, quality, ownership or outcome.
A result may be opened only at its approved access level.
A general legal topic may link to official law without becoming a property-specific conclusion.
Superseded or withdrawn answers must be clearly identified and must not appear as current verified answers.
Search results retain their source and snapshot references.
hard_stops: Never use search similarity as proof of ownership or property identity.
Never expose private case data through public search.
Never rank results as legally better or worse.
Never present a search result as evidence before its underlying approved source is checked.
Never silently convert an old answer into a current answer.
Never infer a person's legal role from a matching name alone.
